evidence.quote: Close Timothy Fries Outside Advisor Tim is the founder and President at JPF Holdings, a private equity firm focused on investing in the lower middle market. Prior to JPF Holdings, he was a member of Baird Capital’s US Private Equity group, where he played a pivotal role in the Global Industrial Solutions sector team. Tim also co-founded Lakeview Capital in 2016, an investment firm focused on early-stage investments in e-commerce and digital media solutions, cryptocurrency, tokenized asset platforms, and blockchain technology ventures. Tim graduated cum laude with a BSE in Mechanical Engineering from the University of Michigan and also earned an MBA from the University of Chicago Booth School of Business. Tim provides investment advice and deal support to Valera Capital. Linkedin Email https://www.linkedin.com/in/timothy-fries/
